tagline: One of you is the spy. The rest of you are at a place. Ask questions.
description:
Everyone but one person is at the same place — a bank, a pirate ship, a circus tent — and each of you has a job there. The spy does not know the place. Ask questions. Try not to give it away. Try to catch the spy. The spy tries to guess where you are.

Pass the phone around so each person can look at their card, then hide it. Or press Play with friends and send the invite: everyone who opens the link is in the same game, each on their own phone. There is no lobby code and no game server. The room is the link.

Tap a place on the list if you think that is where you are. Everyone can see the votes. When the time is up, say who you think the spy is.

An unofficial port of Spyfall by tannerkrewson. The original needs a game server. This copy does not: the invite is the room.
